aub_upgrade_chain_citadel_of_aleppo_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = citadel_of_aleppo_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_citadel_of_aleppo_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = 2000 }
		}
		remove_building = citadel_of_aleppo_01
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = citadel_of_aleppo_02
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = citadel_of_aleppo_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = 2000 }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = citadel_of_aleppo_01
		}
	}
}
